title: 669. Replace Words

examples.input: dictionary = ["cat","bat","rat"], sentence = "the cattle was rattled by the battery"
examples.output: "the cat was rat by the bat"

examples.explanation: Every word starts with one of the single-letter roots.
No word starts with "abc", so nothing changes.

testCases.sentence: the cattle was rattled by the battery

hints: Index every root in a prefix tree (trie) that marks word ends.
For each sentence word, walk the trie and stop at the first end marker: that is the shortest matching root.
If the walk dies before any marker, keep the original word.
